Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of low back pain and stiffness. The reported
mechanism of injury is consistent in kind and force with the lumbar strain diagnosed at intake. Palpation revealed paraspinal
muscle tenderness and restricted lumbar range of motion, and imaging findings clearly support the clinical diagnosis. There is no
known prior injury to the lumbar region in the rceords reviewed. Care consisted of 17 visits including manual therapy, therapeutic
exercise, and home stretching instructions. Treatment followed a typical course, with pain scores and mobility steadily improving
and visit frequency tapering as recovery progressed. At dishcarge the patient reported near-resolution of symptoms and was
released to full activity with a home exercise program. Separately, the billing review notes two similar charges submitted on the
same date of service, which are currently being verified with the billing office.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.

- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.
